regions.today: Generally dry today with a mix of cloud and sunny spells and just well-scattered light showers. Highest temperatures of 17 to 20 degrees, mildest, driest and brightest further east. Southwesterly breezes will be no more than moderate in strength.
regions.tonight: Cloudy outbreaks of rain and drizzle to extend across the province during Sunday night, turning heavy at times. Hill, mist and coastal fog too. Lowest temperatures of 10 to 13 degrees, in a mostly moderate southerly wind.
regions.tomorrow: Monday will start off mostly dull and wet with further outbreaks of rain. Rain will give way to more showery conditions for the afternoon with some sunny spells breaking through. However, odd heavy shower will follow later. Highest temperatures of 17 to 19 degrees, best values again further east, with moderate southwest to west winds.
regions.solar_uv: Moderate to high on Sunday. Locally high in sunshine on Monday, otherwise low to moderate.
